messages.subject: possibilities in lavaan
parts:
Dear all,

Sorry for my unclear previous e-mail.

I would like to ask you again, and much appreciated if you have time to answer it.

I am a newbie in both sem and lavaan.I want to identify direct, indirect effect between variables and include feedback effect between two variables.  I have two latent variables including categorical measures. 
I began using sen with STATA software. In its documentation file, It says it is not possible to identify total, direct, indirect effect when latent variables include categorical variables (they call this type of models as  gsem-generalized linear sen models).

Are there any similar limitations in Lavaan package when we our latent variables include ordinal or dummy variables?

Many thanks
